description: Whether the work is safe right now: saving, saved at a time, or failed. The status line a draft form owes the user, beside its actions. Copy: says whether the work is safe right now, in the fewest words that carry it — "Saved 2 minutes ago", "Could not save". Never "All changes saved" when they are not.

props.name: at
props.description: When the last successful save happened. Read with `state="saved"`.

example:
const [title, setTitle] = useState('Community Outreach Newsletter')const { state, savedAt } = useAutosave(title, async () => {
  await Promise.resolve()
})

<Field label="Title" htmlFor="draft-title">
  <Input id="draft-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => { setTitle(e.target.value) }} />
  
  <SaveStatus state={state} at={savedAt ?? '2026-08-23T09:14:00.000Z'} />
</Field>
